'''Sardor Isle''' {{co|32|53|Feralas}} is located west of mainland [[Feralas]]. On the island's northern shore stands [[Feathermoon Stronghold]], led by the [[night elf]] general [[Shandris Feathermoon]], head of the [[Sentinel Army]]. The night elves keep a watchful eye on the [[Isle of Dread]], located to the south of Sardor Isle, where things most unspeakable now walk the earth.
